title: Scaling Test-time Compute for LLM Agents
authors_zh: King Zhu 等（机构：OPPO AI Agent Team）
paper_type_zh: 智能体测试时计算扩展系统研究
best_for_zh: 将推理时搜索与验证迁移到工具使用智能体的读者。
one_line: This study maps which test-time scaling mechanisms improve tool-using language agents and finds selective reflection, list-wise comparison, and diverse rollouts effective.
该研究系统比较并行采样、选择性反思、列表式验证与多智能体轨迹多样性对语言智能体测试时扩展的影响。
why: It shows that test-time scaling choices interact with agent trajectories, tool actions, and result merging rather than transferring mechanically from single-answer reasoning.
inclusion_reason: It directly studies how parallel rollouts, reflection, verification, merging, and rollout diversity change agent performance under added inference compute.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Methods that improve a single answer by sampling more completions do not transfer directly to agents. An agent has tool calls, observations, intermediate commitments, and accumulated errors; branching every step can explode cost and make a good final rollout less likely. Reflection can correct mistakes, but constant reflection can interrupt a productive trajectory.

The paper asks which test-time scaling choices are useful for tool-using agents rather than isolated question answering. It compares parallel rollout search, sequential revision, verifier and result-merging mechanisms, and ways to diversify rollouts, using GAIA tasks where an agent must search the web and handle multimodal files.

通过采样更多完整回答来改善单个答案的方法，不能直接迁移到智能体。智能体拥有工具调用、观察、中间承诺和累积错误；在每一步分支会使成本爆炸，也可能降低得到好终局轨迹的概率。反思能够纠错，但持续反思会打断本来有效的轨迹。

论文研究哪些测试时扩展选择对工具使用智能体真正有效，而不是只适合孤立问答。它比较并行轨迹搜索、序贯修订、验证和结果合并机制，以及增加轨迹多样性的方式，并使用需要网页搜索和多模态文件处理的 GAIA 任务。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The work treats agentic test-time scaling as four coupled controls. Parallel sampling explores multiple whole or step-wise trajectories; a reflection agent summarizes recent actions only when a verifier score indicates poor progress; verification and result merging choose among candidates; heterogeneous agents diversify the rollout distribution.

The central empirical message is that allocation must respect trajectory structure. Whole-trajectory BoN is stronger than several deeper searches in the reported setting, reflection helps when triggered selectively rather than every step, and list-wise comparison is more useful than independent scalar scoring or majority voting when candidates contain complementary evidence.

该工作把智能体测试时扩展视为四个相互耦合的控制项。并行采样探索多个完整或逐步轨迹；反思智能体只在验证器分数显示当前进展不佳时总结近期动作；验证和结果合并在候选间选择；异构智能体则使轨迹分布更多样。

中心实证信息是分配必须尊重轨迹结构。报告设置中，完整轨迹的最佳候选强于若干更深搜索；反思只在选择性触发时有帮助，而非每一步触发；当候选含有互补证据时，列表式比较比独立标量评分或多数投票更有用。

title: Method
方法
html:
The framework places BoN, step-wise BoN, beam search, and diverse verifier tree search inside a CodeAgent setup. It also compares step-based reflection with score-triggered reflection at thresholds below 8, 5, and 2. For verification and merging, it tests majority voting, scalar PRM scoring, and a list-wise PRM that directly compares candidate thoughts or trajectories; diversity is increased through sampling width and heterogeneous rollout models.

Most experiments use GPT-4.1 with a simplified SmolAgents CodeAgent on 165 GAIA validation examples. Parallel-search comparisons use width four and beam size two. The paper also evaluates mixed Claude and Gemini rollout models. It records final GAIA score by difficulty level, then uses ablations to separate the effects of search algorithm, reflection frequency, verifier form, merging rule, and rollout diversity.

框架把最佳候选、逐步最佳候选、束搜索和多样验证器树搜索放入 CodeAgent 设置。它还比较逐步反思与分数触发反思，阈值分别低于 8、5 和 2。对验证和合并，它测试多数投票、标量 PRM 评分，以及直接比较候选思路或轨迹的列表式 PRM；多样性通过采样宽度和异构轨迹模型增加。

多数实验使用 GPT-4.1 与简化的 SmolAgents CodeAgent，评测 165 个 GAIA 验证样本。并行搜索比较使用宽度四和束宽二。论文还评测混合的 Claude 与 Gemini 轨迹模型。它按难度级别记录最终 GAIA 分数，再用消融区分搜索算法、反思频率、验证形式、合并规则和轨迹多样性的影响。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
With GPT-4.1 on GAIA, the baseline scores 55.76 while BoN reaches 63.03; step-wise BoN reaches 58.79, beam search 56.97, and the reported diverse tree search equals the baseline. The comparison supports the limited claim that parallel whole-trajectory sampling can help agents, but it also shows that deeper branching does not automatically convert more compute into better tool-use outcomes.

Selective reflection at score below 2 reaches 56.36, exceeding both the 55.76 baseline and more frequent thresholds. For result merging, list-wise selection gives 63.03 for BoN versus 56.8 by voting and 59.39 by scoring; similar list-wise gains appear for beam and tree search. These experiments support the paper’s emphasis on timing reflection and comparing candidates jointly.

在 GAIA 上使用 GPT-4.1 时，基线为 55.76，最佳候选达到 63.03；逐步最佳候选为 58.79，束搜索为 56.97，报告中的多样树搜索与基线相同。该比较支持并行完整轨迹采样能帮助智能体这一有限结论，但也显示更深分支并不会自动把更多计算变成更好的工具使用结果。

分数低于 2 时的选择性反思达到 56.36，高于 55.76 的基线和更频繁的阈值。结果合并中，最佳候选的列表式选择为 63.03，而投票为 56.8、评分为 59.39；束搜索和树搜索也出现类似的列表式增益。这些实验支持论文强调反思时机和联合比较候选。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper’s contribution is a controlled map of scaling levers in an agent trajectory, rather than a new isolated search algorithm. It changes the evaluation surface from one prompt and multiple answers to tool-use episodes containing actions, observations, verifier feedback, reflection decisions, and merged candidate trajectories.

What is new is the comparative decision boundary: when to branch, when to reflect, how to verify, and whether diversity should come from multiple agent models. It does not establish a universally optimal agent scaffold. Before reuse, check GAIA tool availability, prompt and model version, list-wise judge calibration, rollout correlation, and the complete cost including tools and judge calls.

论文的贡献是受控绘制智能体轨迹中的扩展杠杆，而不是提出一个孤立的新搜索算法。它把评测面从一个提示和多个答案改为工具使用回合，包含动作、观察、验证反馈、反思决策和合并后的候选轨迹。

新意在于比较性决策边界：何时分支、何时反思、如何验证，以及多样性是否应来自多个智能体模型。它并未证明存在普遍最优的智能体支架。复用前应检查 GAIA 工具可用性、提示与模型版本、列表式评判校准、轨迹相关性，以及工具和评判调用在内的完整成本。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The study uses a small GAIA validation set and proprietary model and tool stacks whose behavior can drift. Its reported budget is mainly search width and strategy choice, not a fully normalized end-to-end cost including web tools, model calls, and list-wise judges. The framework’s conclusions can depend on PRM quality, tool reliability, prompt construction, and the correlation among sampled agents. BoN’s strong result may not hold for tasks with irreversible actions, hidden state, severe tool-rate limits, or very long horizons, so production use needs environment-specific cost and safety controls.
研究使用较小的 GAIA 验证集以及行为可能漂移的专有模型和工具栈。报告预算主要是搜索宽度和策略选择，而不是包含网页工具、模型调用和列表式评判的完整归一化端到端成本。结论可能依赖 PRM 质量、工具可靠性、提示构造和采样智能体之间的相关性。最佳候选的强结果未必适用于不可逆动作、隐藏状态、严格工具限速或极长时域任务，因此生产使用需要针对环境的成本和安全控制。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper as an experiment matrix when extending a tool-using agent at inference time. Evaluate whole-trajectory versus step-wise branching separately, log trigger scores before adding reflection, compare list-wise judges against scalar scores under the same candidate set, and measure diversity rather than merely counting rollouts. The official OAgents repository is the implementation starting point. For a new environment, add replayable tool traces, wall-clock and monetary cost, failure recovery, and a no-side-effects sandbox before trusting higher pass rates.
将工具使用智能体在推理时扩展时，可以把本文作为实验矩阵。应分别评估完整轨迹与逐步分支，在加入反思前记录触发分数，在同一候选集合上比较列表式评判与标量评分，并测量多样性而不只是计算轨迹数量。官方 OAgents 仓库是实现起点。对新环境，应加入可回放工具轨迹、墙钟与货币成本、失败恢复和无副作用沙箱，再相信更高通过率。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: This paper is most useful for its negative results: step-wise expansion and constant reflection are not free improvements. In its setup, spend parallel budget on diverse full rollouts, invoke reflection only on low-score states, and prefer a list-wise comparison when multiple candidate trajectories must be merged. The key unit of analysis is an entire agent episode, so it belongs with test-time scaling but should not be read as evidence about static math sampling alone. Reproduce the GAIA environment before comparing absolute scores.
本文最有用之处在于其负面结果：逐步扩展和持续反思不是免费的改进。在该设置中，应把并行预算花在多样的完整轨迹上，只在低分状态调用反思，并在必须合并多个候选轨迹时偏好列表式比较。分析单位是完整智能体回合，因此它属于测试时扩展，但不应被读成静态数学采样的证据。比较绝对分数前应先复现 GAIA 环境。
